components.css: .ds-terminal{background:#0a0d13;border:1px solid #ffffff24;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 70px -35px #000c,0 15px 70px -40px #8b7bff80;color:var(--ink,#e8edf4);font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-terminal header{padding:13px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2b323e);background:#0f131b;color:var(--soft,#b4bcc8);font:.66rem "JetBrains Mono",monospace}.ds-terminal header span{float:right;font-size:.57rem;color:var(--muted,#a1aaba)}.ds-terminal p{padding:23px 20px 17px;margin:0;font:.73rem "JetBrains Mono",monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-terminal b{color:#b0a5ff;font-weight:400}.ds-terminal ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 20px}.ds-terminal li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;min-height:66px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2b323e);font-size:.76rem}.ds-terminal code{font:.55rem "JetBrains Mono",monospace;color:var(--cyan,#3df5a7)}.ds-terminal footer{padding:18px 20px;color:var(--muted,#a1aaba);font-size:.6rem}

narrative.overview: The React website adapts the user-approved CodeInspectorAi reference: near-black surfaces, mint actions, violet accents, Inter headings and JetBrains Mono metadata. The terminal walkthrough is explicitly illustrative. Frontmatter and this sidecar document React; DESIGN.md separately preserves the unchanged legacy navy/cyan Streamlit system and its animated Three.js vault.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal layers and restrained borders
Mint interaction emphasis with violet accents

rules.name: The Truthful State Rule
rules.body: Sample states never substitute for a real verification result or operational metric.

dos: Do preserve the approved reference across React surfaces.
Do honor reduced motion and retain keyboard focus.
Do preserve separate Streamlit styling and asset licenses.
Do keep guests metadata-only and security descriptions accurate.
donts: Don't describe the unused React Three.js file as the current hero.
Don't imply the sample terminal processed a real file.
Don't invent certifications, client-side encryption or live metrics.
